description: A stately nighttime exterior of a traditional Southern estate gateway. Two large square rendered masonry gate pillars in bright white with applied classical moulding panels and a cornice cap frame the entrance symmetrically. Between them, an ornate black wrought iron gate with arched top panel, decorative circle ring infill, and cast iron spear finials stands partially open. Continuing on each side, matching black wrought iron fencing with the same decorative motif extends outward. A brick or terracotta herringbone-patterned path leads from the sidewalk through the open gateway toward the house. The house in the background is a white two-story colonial-style residence with a dark pitched roof in brown asphalt shingles, a prominent brick chimney, and dark forest green painted shutters flanking the upper windows. Dense mature hardwood trees frame the house and gate on both sides, creating a dark canopy of dark night-green foliage. Low ground plantings of mondo grass or similar accent the pillar bases. Each pillar top holds a tapered lantern-form post-top element with dark black iron frame and seeded or textured glass panels, glowing with warm amber incandescent light that spills down over the white masonry and illuminates the brick path below with a golden cone. The deep night sky is a very dark blue above the roofline. Camera at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition looking directly through the gate toward the house, normal lens. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
